details:
[Problem]

Currently, there is a hard limit of 2,005 user notes per account ("You're not allowed to create more than 2005 user notes!"). For active, long-time VRChat players who meet thousands of people, this limit is far too low. User notes are crucial for remembering who someone is, where we met, or important details about them. Reaching this cap significantly hinders the social experience.

[Suggested Solution]

1. Remove the 2,005 user note limit or significantly increase it (e.g., 50,000 - 100,000 notes).

2. If server storage/cost is a concern, consider offering expanded or unlimited user notes as a VRChat Plus (VRC+) subscriber perk.

3. Add a bulk management tool on the website or in-game menu to search, sort, and clear old/inactive user notes easily.

[Why this matters]

VRChat is a massive social platform where people build long-term relationships over years. Expecting players to remember thousands of acquaintances without notes is unreasonable. Expanding this limit will greatly improve Quality of Life (QoL) for active community members.
title: Increase or remove the 2,005 User Notes limit (or add as VRC+ benefit)
